title: The REFINERY · NEI Robotics Top 10

seasonPreview.title: Last season set the bar. This season starts here.
seasonPreview.intro: The FRC Top 10 is a rewind of 2026 performance and our preseason baseline. Here is the proposed coverage road from fall events to BIOBUZZ, the live build, spring competition, and Houston.

countdown.label: Indiana FTC opening weekend
countdown.note: BIOBUZZ kicked off Sept 12. The first listed Indiana qualifiers are Dec 5–6; FIRST calls that Week 12 since kickoff.

milestones.title: Boiler Bot Battle
milestones.description: This weekend: last season’s robots, fresh ideas, and a first look at the teams to watch.
milestones.note: 2026 offseason competition; part of our 2027 preseason coverage.

milestones.title: Monster Match
milestones.description: Robots, Halloween, and hometown energy. Bring the family for the competition and college and career fair.
milestones.note: Competition 8:15 a.m.–6 p.m. ET; career fair 10 a.m.–2 p.m. Free spectator admission.

milestones.title: The preseason film room
milestones.description: Our proposed November postgame show: what Boiler Bot Battle and Monster Match reveal, the highlights, and the people behind the robots.
milestones.location: Proposed episode · time and watch link TBA

milestones.title: Three teams. One new chapter.
milestones.description: Meet random(), Microchips & Guac, and rookie R.Amp Robotics from Amp Lab. BIOBUZZ is underway; Indiana’s first qualifiers are next.
milestones.location: Proposed FTC preview · time and watch link TBA

milestones.title: Indiana FTC opening weekend
milestones.description: Two Westfield qualifiers start Indiana’s listed competition calendar. We’ll follow results, student stories, and the regional teams as assignments are announced.
milestones.note: Local team assignments are not yet published. This is FIRST’s Week 12 since kickoff, rather than official Week 1.

milestones.title: Meet R.Amp after match one
milestones.description: A rookie team’s first real test: the students, their robot, and what Amp Lab is learning through competition.
milestones.location: Debut date and event assignment TBA
milestones.note: Target Dec 8–9 only if R.Amp debuts on opening weekend; otherwise follow its first official match by 2–3 days.

milestones.title: One robot. Three days. Build it live.
milestones.description: The REFINERY takes on the global Robot in 3 Days challenge. Follow the live build, the tradeoffs, the failures, and the first working machine.
milestones.location: Planned 72-hour build after the Jan 9 noon ET kickoff
milestones.note: Proposed build window. Livestream times, platform, and link TBA.

milestones.title: Week 0: the first full-field test
milestones.description: New robots meet the field before the standings start. We’ll preview readiness, early strategies, and the teams finding their rhythm.
milestones.note: FIRST’s official FRC Week Zero is Feb 20. The local REFINERY scrimmage date is not yet announced.

milestones.title: The new FRC season takes the field
milestones.description: Week 1 starts the spring race. Our first proposed Monday show is March 8, with results, standings, highlights, and our next-week winner picks.
milestones.location: Global FRC Week 1 · Indiana events begin Mar 12

milestones.title: FTC: the Indiana state stage
milestones.description: The postseason arrives for BIOBUZZ. Follow the state contenders and the teams earning the next step toward Houston.
milestones.note: Proposed state review show: Mar 9. Date and venue are from FIRST Indiana’s listing.

milestones.title: Home-field robotics
milestones.description: The FIRST Indiana district circuit comes to Homestead. A local spotlight weekend, followed by our proposed April 5 show.

milestones.title: FRC: the road runs through state
milestones.description: Indiana’s district championship brings the season’s strongest stories together. We’ll break down the bracket, highlights, and Houston qualifiers.

milestones.title: Texas-bound: the Houston preview
milestones.description: Meet the qualifiers, study the field, and make our picks before the biggest stage of the season.
milestones.location: Proposed preview episode · watch link TBA

milestones.title: The world stage. Houston, Texas.
milestones.description: Follow the teams that qualify for FIRST Championship and the stories they bring from Northeast Indiana to a worldwide field.

milestones.note: Proposed season-wrap show: Monday, May 3. Team participation depends on qualification.

edition.label: 2026 FRC
edition.note: 2027 preseason baseline: a rewind of 2026 FRC performance, independently ordered by Statbotics EPA. Frozen June 12, 2026 values; research preserved October 22. This is not a voted poll or a live scoreboard.

scope.label: The REFINERY region · 12 counties
scope.note: Northeast Indiana — The REFINERY 12-county region. A fresh screening of all 69 teams listed on the official 2026 FIRST Indiana district roster found 13 official hometowns within these counties; these match the existing Indiana research cohort. Geography uses official FIRST profile hometown, not workshop location or student residence.

formatExplainer.headline: Two formats. The same team spirit.
formatExplainer.analogy: School football and baseball use enrollment-based classes. FTC and FRC describe different robotics competition formats instead. FIRST programs are chosen by schools and community teams; they are not assigned by school enrollment.
formatExplainer.ftc: FTC: compact robots; grades 7–12; often smaller teams.
formatExplainer.frc: FRC: larger robots; grades 9–12; often larger programs.
formatExplainer.note: A large school can compete in FTC, a small school can compete in FRC, and a school can offer both. Each program has its own championship.
